answer: A payroll anchor stops sybil farming: each identity must link one verified payroll deposit stream from a registered employer, confirmed over three months before trading unlocks. One payroll record maps to one identity; reuse freezes the account. This creates a haven for honest workers, since a fake cannot be minted — the attacker must register a shell company, file payroll taxes and fund deposits, costing about $800 and weeks of paperwork per fake. The delta between one real worker and a thousand bots is then obvious, and no oasis of free accounts remains.
